scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow or dependent of the deceased worker
The deceased worker must have been employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
No minimum service period is required for the worker
No minimum monthly salary is required for the worker
Application must be submitted within two years from the date of the worker's death

Death must be caused by workplace incidents within the organization's premises or on the way to the hospital for treatment, including natural disasters, heart attacks, snake or other poisonous creature bites, fire, or building collapses within the organization
Assistance also extends to widows/dependents of unregistered workers who die or become disabled due to such incidents
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,00,000 is provided to widows/dependents of workers who die while working at the workplace.
